title: Sarfraz Campus, Hyderabad | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Sarfraz Campus, located in Hyderabad, Pakistan. Address: Sarfaraz Chowrangi, Opposite Bin Tayyab Hospital. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=25.3973517,68.3643832. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Hyderabad as the city.
